verdict.rationale: Brex documents virtual card issuance: Mastercard virtual cards, one-click virtual cards in Bill Pay to pay a specific vendor, and bulk virtual-card creation via API integrations. A user also praised its 'dynamic credit card generator.' However, no evidence shows cards can be locked to a single merchant or vendor, which is the core isolation guarantee of the story. missing for 10: documented per-card merchant/vendor locking, explicit SaaS-subscription card workflows, evidence that compromise of one vendor card is isolated from shared credit, independent hands-on corroboration of vendor-specific cards.
